name: unsafe fn drop (slot : & mut ManuallyDrop < T >)
rule: Unless the contained value is a packed struct, `ManuallyDrop::drop(slot)` calls its destructor in place without moving the value.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::mem::manually_drop::ManuallyDrop < T > { unsafe fn drop (slot : & mut core::mem::manually_drop::ManuallyDrop < T >) }
